summary: Winter Garden should retain a standalone municipal control row. Official city sources show an active Winter Garden Police Department with current command staff, patrol, investigations, records, and 2026 public programming, while FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report published Winter Garden Police Department as a normal municipal row and the 2021 legacy report retained a named Winter Garden row even though offense cells were blank. The current all-fill state is therefore a post-2020 reporting/publication continuity break on FL0480500, not contract policing, county replacement, or target invalidity, but no public post-2020 statewide annual backfill row was found.
